changes: Synchronization shows a completed Synced state and time, with explicit checking for new data.
Daily workspace data and the complete posted-report dataset are prepared before use. Reports share downloaded data across periods and report types.
Report loading shows Processing, cancels obsolete period requests and prevents late redraws after navigation. Routine session renewal no longer forces a refresh during work.
Print is restored in expanded Journal History and sub-user History. Long descriptions and line memos wrap on desktop and iPad.
